[264] FineART: Fine-grained Annotated Robotic Trajectory Dataset and Vision-Language-Action Model for Bimanual Manipulation cs.RO | cs.AI | cs.CV | cs.LGPDF

Jade Choghari, Pepijn Kooijmans, Mansi Agarwal, Yusuf Umut Ciftci, Aseem Doriwala

TL;DR: FineART发布密集标注的双臂机器人操作数据集，并训练能预测自身下一子任务的视觉—语言—动作策略以支持长时程多步操作。

Details

Motivation: 真实机器人需完成长时程复杂双臂操作，而非孤立动作。既有数据集虽有大量单臂轨迹，但每段通常只有一条高层指令；少数双臂数据也只覆盖有限小时且子任务标注稀疏。

Result: FineART包含40,543个episode、1,718小时、533,913个子任务，覆盖151项任务。FineART-VLA策略可预测自身下一个子任务；以此方式中训练后，空间消歧任务成功率从32.0%升至100.0%，逐步的人类子任务指导使未见长时任务成功率从16.0%升至76.0%。迁移到新机器人只需少量微调，所需数据为基线的十分之一；还可零样本泛化到新硬件上的完全未见任务。作者开放数据、模型权重和训练代码。

Insight: 对长任务提供细粒度的子任务标注，使策略能在运行中规划下一个阶段，而不只模仿整段轨迹。把子任务预测纳入中训练，可减少换机器人后的数据需求并增强长时程泛化。

Abstract: Robots operating in real-world environments must execute complex, multi-step bimanual tasks over long horizons rather than single, isolated actions. Current manipulation datasets struggle to support this capability: although single-arm datasets reach hundreds of thousands of trajectories, they typically provide only one high-level instruction per episode while the rare bimanual effort that does label subtasks annotates only a fraction of its hours. We present FineART, a densely annotated bimanual manipulation dataset of 40,543 episodes, 1,718 hours, and 533,913 subtasks across 151 tasks. We also introduce FineART-VLA, a vision-language-action policy that predicts its own next subtask, and show that mid-training it this way yields substantial gains. Specifically, success on a spatial disambiguation task increases from 32.0% to 100.0%, and step-by-step human subtask guidance lifts success on an unseen long-horizon task from 16.0% to 76.0%. Furthermore, after minimal fine-tuning on a new robot, the policy requires one-tenth the data of baselines without mid-training and generalizes zero-shot to completely unseen tasks on the new hardware. We open-source the full dataset, model weights, and training code.

[265] Track-and-Complete: Learning Humanoid Skills from a Single Failed Human Video cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Sarmad Idrees, Jongeun Choi

TL;DR: TRACC从一次失败的人类操作视频中提取失败前可用动作轨迹，再以任务完成奖励学习后续动作，使人形机器人无需成功演示也能学技能。

Details

Motivation: 从视频学习机器人技能通常要求成功的人类演示，这需要定制数据采集。失败视频虽未完成任务，但仍包含一段有效轨迹和预期目标，不应只被当作负面样本丢弃。

Result: Track-and-Complete（TRACC）先模仿失败前仍可用的运动前缀，将其作为先验；失败后再用任务完成奖励引导策略达到推断出的目标，不需要一条完整成功轨迹。方法在Oops!数据集的六个野外失败人类任务上评估，实验显示在缺少成功演示时可从失败尝试学习技能；摘要未给具体成功率。

Insight: 失败轨迹能提供局部可行行为和任务意图两类监督：前缀提供运动先验，最终目标奖励则引导策略弥补失败后的部分。将两者分开利用可扩展可用的人类示范来源。

Abstract: Learning humanoid skills from videos typically requires a successful human demonstration, which often demands custom data collection. Although failures have traditionally been treated only as negative examples in robot learning, they can still reveal a usable trajectory prefix before the task fails, as well as the intended outcome. To leverage this information from a failed-attempt video, we propose TRACC, a pipeline that imitates the useful portion of the motion trajectory and then completes the task based on the inferred task outcome. The usable motion prefix serves as prior knowledge until the failure occurs, after which the task-completion reward guides the policy to learn the intended task goal without requiring a successful task trajectory. We evaluate our method on six in-the-wild failed human tasks from the Oops! dataset. Our experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach for learning from failed attempts when no successful demonstration is available. Thus, these findings establish failed human videos as a viable source of supervision for humanoid skill learning.

[266] V2X-WAM: A Cooperative World Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Junwei You, Weizhe Tang, Can Wang, Yan Zhao, Jun Hua

TL;DR: V2X-WAM将车端与基础设施观察、轨迹生成及未来占用预测闭环结合，使自动驾驶规划显式考虑候选动作对未来交通世界的影响。

Details

Motivation: 路侧基础设施可补充车载感知，提供更广泛交通信息，但多数协同驾驶方法只用它增强当前场景表示，很少显式预测候选动作在交通动态变化中的未来后果。

Result: V2X-WAM构建可靠性感知的时空表示，并将基础设施信息压缩为紧凑量化消息以降低通信开销。多模态规划器基于协同表示生成候选轨迹，这些轨迹明确条件化未来占用与动态流预测；再把预测到的世界后果反馈给规划器修正轨迹，形成动作与未来演化闭环。在大规模真实协同驾驶数据集实验中，V2X-WAM相较代表性端到端协同方法持续提升规划准确性和安全性，同时改善未来世界预测并显著降低通信开销；消融研究验证了各设计作用。摘要未列具体指标。

Insight: 协同驾驶不应仅把基础设施观察融合进当前场景，还应将候选动作与未来交通状态联系起来，并据此迭代规划。量化压缩和可靠性感知表示使这种闭环可以兼顾通信效率。

Abstract: Vehicle-infrastructure cooperation can complement onboard sensing with broader and more informative observations of the traffic environment, providing valuable support for end-to-end autonomous driving. However, existing cooperative driving methods mainly exploit roadside information to enhance the representation of the current scene, while the future consequences of prospective driving actions are rarely modeled explicitly. This limits the ability of the planner to anticipate how its decisions may interact with the evolving traffic environment. To address this issue, we propose V2X-WAM, a cooperative world action model that tightly couples cooperative scene understanding, action generation, and future-world reasoning. V2X-WAM constructs a reliability-aware spatiotemporal representation from vehicle- and infrastructure-side observations, while compressing infrastructure information into a compact quantized message for efficient communication. Based on the resulting cooperative representation, a multimodal planner generates prospective trajectories, which explicitly condition future occupancy and dynamic-flow prediction. The predicted world consequences are then fed back to refine the planned trajectory, forming a closed interaction between action and future-world evolution. Experiments on a large-scale real-world cooperative driving dataset demonstrate that V2X-WAM consistently improves planning accuracy and safety over representative end-to-end cooperative driving methods, while achieving stronger future-world prediction and substantially lower communication overhead. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of the proposed design.

[267] RawVLA: Embodied Neural Image Signal Processor For Robotic Manipulation cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Shuhong Liu, Heng Zhou, Lingfeng Qian, Yuhao Fang, Xianbao Hou

TL;DR: RawVLA让神经图像信号处理器直接适配RAW传感器观测，为冻结视觉—语言—动作策略提供与具身行为相关的图像处理。

Details

Motivation: VLA通常接收固定相机ISP输出的RGB图像，将成像流程排除在学习和评估之外。增益、传感器噪声、颜色响应、色调响应和位深等RAW到RGB处理因素可能实质影响动作预测和操作成功。

Result: 作者系统分析五类ISP因素，发现它们对动作预测及操作成功的影响差异显著。RawVLA是流式神经ISP，可为冻结VLA策略自适应渲染RAW观测，并将容量集中到与具身行为相关的成像因素。研究还构建RawVLA-Bench，在干净及恶劣采集条件下将图像处理显式纳入RAW域操作评估。实验显示，RawVLA在标准条件下保持原有性能，并在成像退化时显著提升鲁棒性；摘要未列具体分值。

Insight: 相机ISP不是策略之外的无关预处理，它会改变控制所依赖的视觉证据。把RAW处理纳入具身策略接口，可按任务需求调整成像，并评测系统在退化传感条件下的稳健性。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models typically operate on RGB images produced by a fixed camera image signal processor (ISP), leaving the imaging pipeline outside the learning and evaluation loop. We systematically examine the consequences of this overlooked design choice across five fundamental ISP dimensions: gain, sensor noise, chromatic response, tonal response, and bit depth. Our analysis reveals that RAW-to-RGB processing materially shapes both action prediction and manipulation success, with different ISP dimensions exerting substantially different effects. Guided by these findings, we introduce RawVLA, a streaming neural ISP that adaptively renders RAW observations for frozen VLA policies while concentrating its capacity on the imaging factors relevant to embodied behavior. We further present RawVLA-Bench, a RAW-domain manipulation benchmark to expose image processing as an explicit evaluation variable across clean and adverse acquisition conditions. Experiments on RawVLA-Bench show that RawVLA preserves performance under standard conditions while substantially improving robustness under degraded imaging, establishing adaptive RAW processing as an effective interface between physical cameras and embodied policies.

[268] Learning Social Navigation from Internet Videos in the Policy State Space cs.RO | cs.CV | cs.LGPDF

Jiaming Wang, Duc Thang Nguyen, Jizhuo Chen, Volodymyr Shcherbyna, Diwen Liu

TL;DR: 论文将普通单目步行视频直接转换成社交导航策略状态空间中的闭环训练环境，以可通行地图和回放行人轨迹生成反事实机器人运动。

Details

Motivation: 训练稳健社交导航策略需要覆盖多样布局、地形及人类运动的模拟器，构建环境和手工规定行人行为代价高。作者希望从普通视频中直接提取训练所需信息，而无需重建或渲染完整逼真场景。

Result: 方法将静态场景表示为度量可通行性地图，可随反事实机器人运动刚性变换；从视频恢复的行人轨迹则按时间直接回放。由于社交导航主要取决于机器人可行走区域和附近行人移动，前向动力学可直接在策略状态空间定义并高效模拟，无需重建渲染像素观察。所得策略在独立Arena基准上成功率81.2%，强基线为75.0%；在真实机器人上无需微调，20次试验成功19次。

Insight: 社交导航训练不一定需要从视频重建 photorealistic 世界，若策略只依赖可通行区域和行人运动，可在决策状态空间直接构建闭环反事实环境。该抽象同时降低仿真成本，并在真实机器人测试中展示迁移能力。

Abstract: Training robust social-navigation policies requires simulators with diverse scene layouts, terrain, and human motion, but constructing such environments and specifying pedestrian behavior is costly. We propose an efficient pipeline that converts ordinary monocular walking videos directly into closed-loop social-navigation training environments in the policy’s state space. Our key observation is that local social navigation primarily depends on two types of information: where the robot can traverse and how nearby pedestrians move. We therefore represent the static scene as a metric traversability map, which can be rigidly transformed under counterfactual robot motion, while directly replaying the pedestrian trajectories recovered from the video over time. This abstraction allows us to define the forward dynamics directly in the policy’s state space and efficiently simulate counterfactual robot states without reconstructing or rendering photorealistic observations. The resulting policy achieves 81.2% success in the independent Arena benchmark, compared with 75.0% for the strongest baseline, and succeeds in 19/20 real-robot trials without policy fine-tuning.

[269] CogWAM: Aligning Semantic Cognition with World Action Modeling via Event-Driven Interfaces cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Sen Wang, Liu Liu, Xinjiang Wang, Zequn Chen, Haoyi Jiang

TL;DR: CogWAM用持久语义状态记录已完成事件和当前子任务，并以进度条件化的世界与动作查询连接高层任务理解和机器人控制。

Details

Motivation: 机器人策略越来越多地结合语义推理和未来世界预测，但两者并存并不保证动作与任务进展同步。局部预测和动作若缺少任务级进度接口，模型难以保持跨动作块的整体目标。

Result: CogWAM只在观察到语义转变时更新持久Semantic State，保存已完成事件和当前子任务，使任务上下文跨多个动作块延续。进度条件化WORLD与ACTION查询分别提取与任务相关的信息用于未来世界预测和动作生成；训练时共享语义进度状态，推理时移除未来预测分支，直接根据观察和持久状态生成动作。语义训练策略进一步改进转移学习及闭环条件化。无需额外机器人动作预训练，CogWAM在RoboDojo得分/成功率为15.56/11.70%，并在BiCoord达到当前最佳；真实实验中完成闭环双臂操作，Semantic State重新生成次数比逐步更新少16.4次。

Insight: 持久的事件级状态可将高层任务进度带入后续局部动作，避免每一步重新推断完整任务。预测和行动共用该状态，而部署时去掉预测分支，有利于训练目标与实时控制协同。

Abstract: Robot policies increasingly incorporate semantic reasoning and future-world prediction, yet combining these capabilities does not guarantee that local predictions and actions remain aligned with task progress. We introduce CogWAM, a cognition-guided world-action model that establishes an explicit semantic interface between task reasoning and world-action learning through a persistent Semantic State, which stores completed task events and the active subtask. CogWAM updates this state only when observations indicate semantic transitions, allowing task-level context to persist across multiple action chunks. To bridge semantic context with physical prediction and control, CogWAM employs progress-conditioned WORLD and ACTION queries that selectively extract task-relevant information for future-world prediction and action generation. During training, the Semantic State provides shared task-progress context for both branches, while inference removes the future-prediction branch and directly generates actions from observations and the maintained state. We further introduce semantic training strategies to improve transition learning and closed-loop conditioning. Without additional robot-action pretraining, CogWAM achieves 15.56 / 11.70 % Score/SR on RoboDojo and state-of-the-art performance on BiCoord, while real-world experiments demonstrate closed-loop dual-arm manipulation with 16.4 fewer Semantic State regenerations than step-wise updating.

[270] PhysWAM: Physically Consistent World Action Model for Autonomous Driving cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Dhruv Parikh, Fengcheng Yu, Quankai Gao, Jiawei Yang, Junjie Ye

TL;DR: PhysWAM在同一流匹配Transformer内联合生成多视角视频、度量深度和自车运动，并通过点云投影约束保证世界预测和动作之间的几何一致性。

Details

Motivation: 世界动作模型联合预测场景变化与智能体动作，但联合生成本身并未确保两者共享几何约束。自动驾驶需要保证深度、运动和观测场景物理相符。

Result: PhysWAM将多视角视频、度量深度和自车运动放入统一模型共同去噪。耦合点投影CPP把生成深度反投影成三维点，以生成的SE(3)自车运动变换，再与使用记录运动变换的LiDAR点云比较距离，从而联合监督深度和运动的物理一致性。推理时仅用无标签共识规则选择轨迹，不使用学习评分器或模拟器反馈。在NAVSIM v1/v2规划、零样本闭环迁移及未来视频/度量深度预测评估中，方法规划表现强且可迁移到未见驾驶环境，同时生成准确度量深度和时间连贯视频；CPP改善规划和深度预测。摘要未列具体数值。

Insight: 把深度点云与自车运动放入同一个几何关系中，可为世界生成和动作预测提供直接共享约束。无学习评分器的轨迹选择也表明物理一致建模可与简单推理时决策配合。

Abstract: World-action models (WAMs) jointly predict how a scene will evolve and how an agent should act, however joint generation alone does not necessarily impose a shared geometric constraint on these predictions. We present PhysWAM, a unified world-action model for autonomous driving that co-denoises multiview video, metric depth, and ego motion within a single flow-matching transformer. To ground world and action generation in measured scene geometry, we introduce Coupled Point Projection (CPP) that unprojects the generated depth into 3D points, transforms them using the generated $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ ego motion, and minimizes their distance to LiDAR points transformed using the recorded ego motion. This geometric constraint promotes physical consistency with the measured scene by jointly supervising generated depth and motion alongside their standard flow-matching objectives. At inference, trajectory selection relies only on a simple label-free consensus rule, with no learned scorer or simulator feedback. We evaluate PhysWAM across NAVSIM v1 and v2 planning, zero-shot closed-loop transfer, and future video and metric-depth prediction. Despite PhysWAM’s simple selection procedure, it achieves strong planning performance and transfers zero-shot to unseen driving environments. It also generates accurate metric depth and temporally coherent video, with CPP improving both planning and depth prediction. Together, these results demonstrate that the geometric relationship between scene depth and ego motion provides a direct way to couple world and action generation within a simple unified model.

[271] WorldLine: Action-Driven Visual Simulation for Robotic Manipulation cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Shenghe Zheng, Wenbo Li, Jiyao Zhang, Bin Xia, Haoyang Huang

TL;DR: WorldLine从大量无动作标签机器人视频学习可迁移动力学，再用多种机器人动作轨迹做具身对齐，构成可用于策略评估和规划的动作驱动视觉模拟器。

Details

Motivation: 真实机器人学习受限于经验采集和候选行为评估成本。视频生成可提供可扩展视觉模拟基础，但模型常重视画面逼真而忽视动作遵循与机器人—物体动力学；现有动作条件模拟器又依赖稀缺且难跨控制空间共享的具身数据。

Result: WorldLine用超过10,000小时无动作标签机器人视频学习操作动力学，再用超过2,000小时、十多种具身平台动作轨迹进行动作落地。图像空间动作表示提供跨具身控制接口，多视角及失败样本增强训练结合关系正则提升交互敏感预测，机器人特定少步蒸馏实现高效因果rollout并保留关键运动。在留出及域外设置中，视觉质量和机器人运动一致性强；失败轨迹上机器人掩码IoU比最强基线高0.1626。在RoboTwin和AgiBot上预测轨迹成功的平均准确率74%，高于基线1个百分点。无需RoboTwin训练或适配时，其rollout比直接执行策略最多提升21.4个百分点任务成功率。

Insight: 可迁移动力学学习与异构动作接口可分阶段处理：大量无动作视频用于学习视觉动力学，多具身轨迹用于动作对齐。失败数据、关系约束和因果少步rollout则补足动作模拟的交互质量。

Abstract: Real-world robot learning is constrained by the cost of collecting experience and evaluating candidate behaviors. Video generation models offer a scalable foundation for visual simulators that predict action outcomes before physical execution. Yet they often favor visual plausibility over accurate action following and coherent robot–object dynamics, while action-conditioned simulators depend on scarce, embodiment-specific data that are difficult to share across incompatible control spaces. We introduce WorldLine, an action-driven visual simulator that decouples transferable dynamics learning from heterogeneous action grounding. WorldLine learns manipulation dynamics from more than 10,000 hours of action-free robot videos and grounds them using over 2,000 hours of action trajectories across more than ten embodiments. An image-space action representation provides a shared control interface across embodiments, while multi-view and failure-enriched training with relational regularization improves interaction-sensitive prediction. Robot-focused few-step distillation enables efficient causal rollout while preserving action-critical motion. Across held-out and out-of-domain settings, WorldLine maintains strong visual quality and robot-motion agreement; on failed trajectories, it improves robot-mask IoU by 0.1626 over the strongest baseline. It predicts trajectory success with 74% mean accuracy across RoboTwin and AgiBot, one percentage point above the strongest baseline. Without RoboTwin training or adaptation, its rollouts improve task success by up to 21.4 percentage points over direct policy execution. Together, these capabilities make WorldLine a scalable and efficient visual simulator for policy evaluation and embodied planning. More results are available at \href{https://zhengsh123.github.io/WorldLine/}{project page}.

[272] Counterfactual Video Generation Enables Scalable Humanoid Loco-Manipulation cs.RO | cs.CV | cs.GRPDF

Zihan Wang, Zhen Wu, Pieter Abbeel, Rocky Duan, Jitendra Malik

TL;DR: PRISM将少量真实人—物交互视频扩增为多样反事实生成视频，经接触锚定的实到仿流程重建并物理化，再训练可泛化的人形机器人移动操作策略。

Details

Motivation: 通过视觉模仿教人形机器人搬运不同物体很有前景，但收集多样、高质量交互视频困难，尤其难同时看到完整人体和无遮挡物体接触。

Result: PRISM先从少数真实示例视频用视频到视频生成产生数百个多样反事实人—物交互视频，再通过接触锚定的真实到仿真流程重建人体与物体运动，将不完美视频数据重定向为物理合理轨迹。类内多样性支持训练一个可泛化到类别内未见物体的策略。完整流程在真实机器人部署，不做真实世界微调；仅使用机载深度观察，即可对箱子、桶、收纳箱和球等新实例、尺寸及初始配置完成拾取、搬运和放置。摘要未报告任务成功率。

Insight: 少量真实示例可通过反事实视频生成扩展交互变化，再由接触约束和物理重定向过滤生成数据与机器人动力学之间的差异。按物体类别共享策略，能在新实例上迁移而不依赖真实机器人微调。

Abstract: Teaching humanoids loco-manipulation skills, such as carrying diverse objects, via visual imitation is a promising path toward generalist robots. However, collecting diverse, high-quality interaction videos, such as clips that clearly show a person’s full body and unoccluded interactions with objects, poses a practical barrier to scaling this approach. We propose PRISM, a real-to-sim-to-real framework that overcomes this limitation by amplifying a handful of real videos into a large, diverse training set. PRISM first generates hundreds of diverse “counterfactual” human-object interaction videos via video-to-video (V2V) generation from a few exemplar real videos. Our contact-anchored real-to-sim pipeline then reconstructs both human and object motions, retargeting this imperfect video data into physically plausible trajectories. The intra-class variability across these counterfactual videos lets us train a single policy that generalizes to unseen objects within each category. We demonstrate the full pipeline by deploying this policy on a real robot without any real-world fine-tuning. Using only onboard depth observations, our humanoid picks up, carries, and drops objects, including boxes, barrels, bins, and balls, across novel instances, sizes, and initial configurations.

[273] Better Behavioral Prediction, More Faithful Model Ablations? Evidence from Sequential Choice q-bio.NC | cs.CLPDF

Hanbo Xie

TL;DR: 在已知真实决策策略的序贯选择任务中，作者发现高预测准确率并不保证模型消融能忠实反映真实行为对输入信息的依赖。

Details

Motivation: 研究者常通过移除输入信息并观察预测性能变化，来推断这些信息对行为的重要性；这种解释成立的前提是模型依赖信息的方式能代表行为生成机制。作者在生成策略已知的合成任务中检验这一前提。

Result: 研究比较两种合成序贯老虎机任务中的 GRU、Transformer、微调 LLaMA 和认知模型，并改变奖励贡献。作者区分无奖励观测训练后的预测，以及对固定预测器替换供体奖励的响应。其一，在非平稳任务中，不看奖励训练的神经模型预测留出选择优于四种简单行为基线；其二，在匹配的供体替换实验中，准确预测器对干预的响应可能远弱于真实生成策略；其三，某些奖励权重下神经网络虽比合并强化学习模型预测更好，对选择概率变化的忠实度却更差，而且模型排序随任务改变。摘要未给具体数值。

Insight: 预测所需的信息与干预时应引起的真实行为变化不是同一性质。若要用输入消融解释行为机制，必须独立验证模型对消融的响应忠实度，不能仅凭预测准确率推断生成过程。

Abstract: Using predictive models to explain cognition requires more than accurate behavioral predictions. Input ablations offer an appealing route: remove information from a model and interpret the resulting performance change as evidence of its importance for behavior. Yet this inference assumes that the model’s dependence on information reflects the dependence of the process generating the behavior. We test it in two synthetic sequential bandit tasks with known generating policies, where past choices can remain informative when feedback is unavailable to a predictor. We compare GRUs and Transformers trained from scratch, a fine-tuned LLaMA model, and cognitive models across systematically varied reward contributions. Our analyses distinguish prediction after training without reward observations from the response of a fixed predictor to donor-reward replacement. Three findings emerge. First, in the restless task, neural models trained without rewards predict held-out choices better than four simple training-fitted behavioral baselines. Second, under matched donor replacement, accurate predictors can respond much less than the known generator. Third, at some reward weights, neural networks predict better than a pooled reinforcement-learning model but have less faithful changes in choice probabilities; the model ordering differs between the two tasks. These independent-test results separate information sufficient for prediction from response fidelity under a specified ablation in sequential choice. They motivate validating model-ablation responses independently of predictive performance before using them to infer how the observed behavior was generated.
